notes.message: 845 more trials mention the drug or condition only in descriptions, often as one of several permitted options. They are listed under mentions but not counted. Set retrieval.name_matching to mentioned to count them.
Obesity also includes trials whose MeSH condition is "Diabesity" or "Prader-Willi Syndrome", which sit under it in the MeSH tree.
2026 is still in progress (registry data as of 2026-11-06); periods after 2026 count trials planned for then.
